reason: Code review found the preserved legacy dataset adapter stretches arbitrary source aspect ratios to 512x288. A separately versioned correction is required for the handoff's native-aspect preprocessing contract.
supersedes: The v2/v3 validation-only selection plan for the active application. Both completed stretch baselines remain evidence, but cannot satisfy the aspect-preserving runtime contract. This is a correctness correction, not a test-driven accuracy search.
preprocessing: Aspect-preserving RGB bilinear/mask-nearest letterbox; black RGB padding, synthetic mask sentinel 254 -> ignored target 255. Real source 255 remains learned background. Exclude padding from loss and evaluation.
runtime_projection: Crop model-grid padding, argmax, nearest-neighbor project labels into the EXIF-oriented source frame; record actual x/y scales and padding. Source-size logits/softmax are avoided to bound memory.
training_recipe: Retain v3's predeclared positive sampling weight 8, minimum pothole CE weight 32, soft Dice weight 0.5 and train-only flip/brightness augmentation; make Dice ignore-safe for padding.
selection: Within this corrected run, best validation macro IoU only. Deploy the corrected preprocessing identity regardless of whether its heldout score exceeds the old stretch baselines.
split: Same frozen source image/mask identities, sequences and duplicate exclusions; no new data source or relabelling.
limits: One corrective run; no claim of accurate pothole masks, calibrated uncertainty or source-resolution geometry accuracy without actual validation. Prior negative experiments are retained.
